name: Armor
note: Sets AC to 6 (never worsens it); not cumulative with the shield spell. Ends when cumulative damage taken exceeds 8 + level; the armor does not absorb that damage.

name: Chill Touch
note: Touch attack. A failed save also costs 1 Strength (1 point back per hour); undead are turned instead of damaged. Only the damage is modelled.

name: Chromatic Orb
note: The gem's effect on a hit is the DM's call: the app spends the gem and rolls the to-hit only.

name: Color Spray
note: Affects 1d6 creatures by Hit Dice: lower or equal to caster level are unconscious 2d4 rounds, 1-2 above are blinded 1d4 rounds, others are stunned; saves per the text.

name: Enlarge
note: Damage rolls grow proportionally with size: multiplier = 100% + 10% per caster level, result rounded up. Hit points, AC, attack rolls and Strength/class/magic bonuses are unchanged. Unwilling targets save to negate. Reverse spell: reduce.

name: Expeditious Retreat
note: Movement rate tripled; large jumps.

name: Fire Burst
note: 1 point per level, max 10. Cast on a nonmagical fire; 10-ft radius around it.

name: Fist of Stone
note: Fist attacks as if Strength 18/00 (combat bonuses only for the fist). Caster cannot cast spells with somatic components meanwhile.

name: Friends
note: +2d4 Charisma for reaction checks of intelligent creatures in a 60-ft radius.

name: Magic Missile
note: Each missile 1d4+1; one missile at level 1, +1 per two further levels, max 5 (level 9). Never misses; may be split between targets.

name: Protection From Evil
note: Evil (or evilly enchanted) attackers -2 to hit and the bearer saves +2 against their attacks; also blocks possession/mental control and bodily contact from summoned or extraplanar creatures. Ends if the bearer attacks the blocked creature in melee.
condition: attacks and saves against evil creatures

name: Ray of Fatigue
note: Debuff: adds one level of encumbrance (-1/-2/-4 to attack, AC worse by 1/3). Not modelled.

name: Shield
note: Blocks magic missile entirely. AC 2 vs hurled missiles, 3 vs device-propelled missiles, 4 vs everything else; +1 to saves against frontal attacks. Only for attacks coming from the front.
condition: attacks originating from in front of the caster

name: Shocking Grasp
note: Touch attack; the charge stays for 1 round per level or until discharged.

name: Sleep
note: Affects 2d4 Hit Dice of creatures (none with 4+3 HD or more), weakest first; no save.

name: Blindness
note: Until dispelled or removed by the caster; cure spells do not work. Blinded creature -4 to attack, opponents +4 to hit it.

name: Blur
note: Attacks against the caster: -4 on the first attempt, -2 on every later attempt; +1 to saves against direct magical attacks.
condition: save bonus applies to direct magical attacks only

name: Cat’s Grace
note: Dexterity gain by class group; cannot raise Dexterity to 20 or more; not cumulative with other Dexterity magic.

name: Choke
note: Hands deal 1d4 per round (save half), -2 to attack; duration missing from the source text. Not modelled.

name: Displace Self
note: Attacks against the caster: first automatically misses, later ones -2; +2 to saves against targeted spells. Not modelled.

name: Flaming Sphere
note: 2d4 fire to creatures in contact (save negates); those within 5 ft also take 1d4 heat (save negates), not modelled. Sphere rolls 30 ft/round.

name: Ghoul Touch
note: Touch paralyses 1d6+2 rounds; stench gives -2 to attacks. Not modelled.

name: Glitterdust
note: Failed save: blinded (-4 to attack, saves and AC) for 1d4+1 rounds; outlines invisible creatures. Not modelled.

name: Ice Knife
note: Missile attack roll for 2d4. On impact a 5-ft burst of numbing cold affects creatures that fail a save vs paralyzation; the save listed negates that burst, not the 2d4.

name: Irritation
note: Itching: AC worse by 4 and -2 to attack for 3 rounds; rash: -4 Charisma/-2 Dexterity. Not modelled.

name: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp
note: Held victim: movement 0, AC and attack penalties (-2). Not modelled.

name: Melf's Acid Arrow
note: Hits as a fighter of the caster's level (no range modifiers). 2d4 acid per round; the acid lasts 1 round plus 1 per three levels. Saving throws only for items.

name: Mirror Image
note: 1d4 images plus 1 per three levels, max 8. Each image vanishes when an attack is aimed at it.

name: Pyrotechnics
note: Fireworks blind 1d4+1 rounds; smoke imposes -2 to combat rolls and AC. Not modelled.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
note: Debuff: humanoids man-size or smaller drop to Strength 5 (-2 attack, -1 damage); others -2 attack and -1 per damage die. Not modelled.

name: Shatter
note: Damages crystalline creatures 1d6 per level (max 6d6). Not modelled.

name: Spectral Hand
note: +2 to the touch attack roll when delivering touch spells. Not modelled.

name: Strength
note: Strength gain by class group (a bard is a rogue: 1d6). Never confers 19 or more; not cumulative with other Strength magic. A warrior with 18 Strength instead adds 10%-80% to the exceptional roll (not modelled). Creatures with no Strength score get +1 to attack and damage.

name: Summon Swarm
note: Swarm doing 1d4 + 1 per three levels each round (save negates, 1 point if defending only). Not modelled.

name: Tasha's Uncontrollable Hideous Laughter
note: Victim loses 2 Strength (or -2 to attack and damage) after the first round of laughter. Not modelled.

name: Wall of Gloom
note: -2 to missile attacks through the wall; fear effect. Not modelled.

name: Alamir's Fundamental Breakdown
note: Caster takes 4d8 if the item analysis goes wrong. Not modelled.

name: Bone Club
note: Weapon: club +4 vs undead (1d6+4), +1 otherwise (1d6+1). Not modelled.

name: Delay Death
note: Target keeps acting down to -10 hit points with -2 to attacks and saves. Not modelled.

name: Explosive Runes
note: Trap on a written work: 6d4+6 to the reader, no save (the reader may only be spared if the caster is the reader).

name: Flame Arrow
note: Bolt version: 1d6 piercing + 4d6 fire per bolt, one bolt per five levels (half the fire damage on a save). The alternative version only adds 1 fire damage to normal arrows or bolts and is not modelled.

name: Haste
note: Up to caster-level creatures in a 40-ft cube get double movement and attacks and -2 initiative. Spellcasting is not sped up. Ages each recipient 1 year. Negates slow; not cumulative.

name: Hovering Skull
note: Skull bites for 1d6 (3 hit points). Not modelled.

name: Invisible Mail
note: Sets AC to 3 and absorbs 1 hit point per level of damage. Not modelled.

name: Lance of Disruption
note: 5-ft x 60-ft beam; half damage to amorphous or nonsolid creatures.

name: Lesser Sign of Sealing
note: Trap: 1d8+level damage to whoever forces the sealed portal (half on a save). Not modelled.

name: Maximilian's Stony Grasp
note: Held victim with stone hand; damage and penalties in the text. Not modelled.

name: Melf's Minute Meteors
note: One 1d4 globe per caster level, +2 to hit, no range penalty; five per round or one per round. Misses deal 1 to creatures within 3 ft.

name: Minor Malison
note: Enemies in the area make all saving throws at -1 (or -2 against one chosen school of magic); not cumulative with a specialist penalty.

name: Pain Touch
note: Needs a successful touch attack. No damage; 1d4 rounds of -2 to hit and AC worsened by 2.

name: Protection From Evil, 10' Radius
note: As protection from evil, but covers a 10-ft radius around the creature touched; protected creatures break the warding against enchanted or summoned monsters by meleeing them.
condition: attacks and saves against evil creatures

name: Protection From Normal Missiles
note: Invulnerable to normal missiles; large or magical missiles lose 1 per damage die. Not modelled.

name: Skulltrap
note: Trap with a damaging burst when the skull is disturbed. Not modelled.

name: Slow
note: Up to caster-level creatures in a 40-ft cube. Half movement and attacks, +4 AC (worse), -4 to attack, Dexterity combat bonuses negated. Saves against the spell take -4. Negates haste.

name: Snapping Teeth
note: Extra bite attack 1d4 per round. Not modelled.

name: Solvent of Corrosion
note: Acid: 1d3 per level per sq ft vs stone/metal/wood monsters; 1 per level (round 1 only) vs flesh. Not modelled.

name: Spirit Armor
note: AC 4 (splint mail) and +3 to saves against magical attacks; not cumulative with other armor or magical protection; Dexterity bonuses apply.
condition: save bonus applies to magical attacks only

name: Vampiric Touch
note: Touch attack. Drains 1d6 per two levels (max 6d6) and heals the caster by that many (excess as temporary hit points, lost first). Ends on a successful touch or after one turn.

name: Watery Double
note: Failed save: 1d8 damage per round until destroyed. Not modelled.

name: Brainkill
note: Failed save: 1-6 damage and memory loss. Not modelled.

name: Contagion
note: Debuff: Str/Dex/Cha -2 and -2 to attack until cured. Not modelled.

name: Dig
note: 4d6 damage to earth-bound creatures; excavation. Not modelled.

name: Emotion
note: Picks one of eight emotions (e.g. courage: +1 attack, +3 damage, +5 hp; hope +2). Not modelled.

name: Enchanted Weapon
note: Gives one large or two small weapons +1 to attack and damage rolls (the weapon is treated as magical).

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
note: Area of tentacles attacking creatures every round. Not modelled.

name: Fire Aura
note: Fire immunity; 2d4 damage to anyone touching the aura. Not modelled.

name: Fire Shield
note: Personal shield returning damage to melee attackers and changing fire/cold saves. Not modelled.

name: Greater Malison
note: Hostile creatures in the area make all saving throws at -2 (or -3 against one chosen school); not cumulative with a specialist penalty.

name: Ice Storm
note: Picked when casting. Hail: 3d10 in a 40-ft-diameter area for one round. Sleet: no damage; it blinds, makes the ground icy (half movement, a chance to slip) and puts out small fires in an 80-ft-diameter area for one round per level (not tracked).

name: Improved Invisibility
note: Attacks against the creature take -4 and its saves get +4. The recipient can attack, shoot and cast and stay unseen.

name: Improved Strength
note: Strength gain by class group with higher caps (a bard is a rogue: 1d6+4, max 23). Each exceptional-Strength bracket counts as one point. When it ends the recipient must rest for 1d3 full turns.

name: Mordenkainen's Celerity
note: +2 to saves against movement-affecting spells; longer movement spells. Not modelled.

name: Mordenkainen’s Force Missiles
note: Each missile 2d4 (no save) plus a burst of 1 per level (a save vs. spell negates the burst only), rolled as two parts; one missile at level 7, +1 per three levels after, max 7 at level 25. Below level 7 (cast from a device) one missile.

name: Psychic Protection
note: +6 to saves (or a save where none is allowed) against spells that control or destroy the mind; such attempts fail automatically per the text.
condition: saves against mind-controlling or mind-destroying effects

name: Shout
note: Also deafens for 2d6 rounds; a save negates the deafness and halves the damage.

name: Stoneskin
note: Blocks 1d4 attacks plus 1 per two caster levels, physical or magical; magical effects still apply their normal effects. Not cumulative with itself.

name: Thunder Staff
note: Stuns 1d3 rounds, deafens, hurls 4d4+4 feet with 1 damage per two feet (save half). Not modelled.

name: Turn Pebble to Boulder
note: Missile attack roll with the caster's THAC0, no range penalty; damage on a hit only.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
note: First round (min(level,12))d4, half on a save. A failed save keeps the acid burning in following rounds with two fewer dice each round, a new save each round ending it: every round is rolled, drop the rounds after a successful save. Not modelled: the 5-ft splash on secondary targets (1d4 per five levels, save vs. paralyzation negates).

name: Wall of Fire
note: The heat on the side the caster picks deals 2d4 within 10 ft and 1d4 within 20 ft each round; passing through the wall deals 2d6 + 1 per caster level. Each is an exposure, picked when rolling. Lasts while the caster concentrates, or 1 round per level. Undead and creatures subject to fire take more (the DM's).

name: Wall of Ice
note: Three castings, picked when casting. Ice plane: a creature breaking through takes 2 damage per inch of thickness (1 inch per caster level; 3 per inch for fire users, 1 for cold users), not rolled at casting. Hemisphere: no damage. Ice sheet: falls on the creatures beneath for 3d10, as Ice Storm hail.

name: Wind Breath
note: Wind force by level; trivial damage. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Interposing Hand
note: Force hand imposing -10 to enemy attack/obstructing. Not modelled.

name: Cloudkill
note: Creatures under 4+1 HD die; 4+1 to 5+1 HD save vs. poison at -4 or die; up to 6 HD save vs. poison or die (no damage roll: the DM's). Stronger creatures take 1d10 poison for each round in the cloud, rolled as an exposure. The cloud rolls away from the caster at 10 ft per round.

name: Cone of Cold
note: 1d4+1 per level, no stated cap.

name: Dream
note: Nightmare variant deals 1d10 damage. Not modelled.

name: Force Shapechange
note: Shapechangers take 3d10 on a failed save. Not modelled.

name: Mind Fog
note: Targets take -2 on saves against mind-affecting and low-level spells. Not modelled.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
note: Phantom dog bites 3d6 as a 10 HD monster. Not modelled.

name: Mummy Rot
note: Touch attack: 2d6 always (the save only avoids the disease). The rot kills in 1d6 months, costs 2 Charisma per month and slows healing to 10%; only the damage is modelled. The touch stays ready for 1 round per level.

name: Tenser’s Destructive Resonance
note: Destroys one object; no creature damage. Not modelled.

name: Throbbing Bones
note: Debuff: AC worse by 2, reduced movement, damage on movement (save half). Not modelled.

name: Vortex*
note: Wild-magic vortex dealing 1d4 per level (save half). Not modelled.

name: Wall of Bones
note: Creatures forcing through take 1d8 per 10 feet. Not modelled.

name: Waveform*
note: Wild-magic water form dealing 1d4 per level (save half). Not modelled.

name: Arrow of Bone
note: Enchanted missile with special attack and damage rules. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Forceful Hand
note: Force hand pushing opponents. Not modelled.

name: Chain Lightning
note: The first strike is (min(level,12))d6, half on a save; the bolt then arcs to further targets, each jump 1d6 weaker, each with its own save, for as many strikes as the caster has levels. Every strike the bolt can make is rolled (the most there can be): drop the strikes past the last target.

name: Claws of the Umber Hulk
note: Claw attacks and burrowing. Not modelled.

name: Corpse Host
note: Minor self-damage when harvesting flesh. Not modelled.

name: Dead Man's Eyes
note: Gaze kills low-HD victims, others paralysed or stunned; saves at -2 for some. Not modelled.

name: Death Fog
note: Acidic solid fog: a creature takes 1 point on its first round of exposure, 2 on the second, 4 on the third and 8 on each round after, rolled as exposures. Movement through it is 1 ft per unit of movement rate.

name: Demishadow Magic
note: Quasi-real evocations at 40% damage. Not modelled.

name: Dimensional Blade
note: Weapon gets +2 to attack and damage and cuts anything. Not modelled.

name: Dragon Scales
note: Improves AC by 2 (e.g. 6 becomes 4), in addition to normal AC.

name: Eyebite
note: Gaze effects (fear, sicken, ...) chosen at casting. Not modelled.

name: Forest's Fiery Constrictor
note: Fiery tentacle attacking creatures (save or take damage). Not modelled.

name: Ghoul Gauntlet
note: Victim loses 1-2 hit points per round while transforming. Not modelled.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
note: Ray of cold 1d4+2 per level or other modes. Not modelled.

name: Superior Magnetism
note: Magnet with damaging effects (2d6). Not modelled.

name: Tenser's Transformation
note: Caster hit points double (damage hits the extra points first, later damage doubled), AC 4 better, fights as a fighter of the same level with dagger (2 attacks, +2 damage) or staff (+2 to hit and damage).

name: Tentacles
note: Two extra attacks per round, 1d6 each. Not modelled.

name: Transmute Water to Dust
note: Living creatures take 1d6 per level (half on a save). Not modelled.

name: Trollish Fortitude
note: Regenerates 3 hit points per round up to normal maximum; ignores dismemberment/decapitation.

name: Acid Storm
note: Area acid downpour (save half); damage dice not given in the seed text. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Grasping Hand
note: Force hand grappling for damage by round. Not modelled.

name: Bloodstone's Frightful Joining
note: Risk of 5d6 damage on a failed system shock. Not modelled.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
note: A fireball with +1 per die (max 10d6+10, as Fireball); the blast can be delayed up to 5 rounds.

name: Duo-Dimension
note: Cannot be hit when turned sideways; double damage when visible. Not modelled.

name: Finger of Death
note: Kills on a failed save; 2d8+1 damage on a save. Not modelled.

name: Hatch the Stone from the Egg
Malec-Keth's Flame Fist
note: Touch: 1d4+2 fire, or on a failed save 1d4 per level for one round. Not modelled.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
note: Force sword attacking as a fighter of half level: 5d4 vs man-size, 5d6 vs larger. Not modelled.

name: Prismatic Spray
note: Seven rays with different damage and effects. Not modelled.

name: Seven-Eyes
note: Seven orbs with different rays; some strike for 1d4+1. Not modelled.

name: Spell Turning
note: Rebounds spells onto the original caster. Not modelled.

name: Suffocate
note: Each round Constitution check or 2d4 damage. Not modelled.

name: Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting
note: 1d8 per level, no stated cap; double penalty to save for water elementals and plants.

name: Bigby's Clenched Fist
note: Force fist striking one opponent per round for damage. Not modelled.

name: Death Shroud
note: Aura that drains life from touching creatures. Not modelled.

name: Gunther's Kaleidoscopic Strike
note: Beam with several possible effects. Not modelled.

name: Heart of Stone
note: Takes only 1 damage from piercing or slashing attacks. Not modelled.

name: Incendiary Cloud
note: The cloud flames from its third round: 1d2 per caster level, then 1d4 per level on the fourth and 1d2 per level on the fifth; later rounds are harmless smoke. A save halves; a creature that saves once needs no further save, one that fails saves again on the fourth and fifth rounds.

name: Iron Body
note: Resistances to many attacks, fists hit harder. Not modelled.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
note: Dancing victim: AC worse by 4, saves at -10, cannot attack. Not modelled.

name: Prismatic Wall
note: Layered colours with damage (e.g. 20/40/80 points) and effects. Not modelled.

name: Shadow Form
note: Shadow touch 1d4+1 and 1 Strength drain; resistances. Not modelled.

name: Bigby's Crushing Hand
note: Force hand constricting for damage each round. Not modelled.

name: Meteor Swarm
note: Four large spheres of 10d4 or eight small ones of 5d4, picked when casting, each bursting as a fireball (one save per area for half); a creature in the straight-line path takes the full effect without a save. A creature takes the spheres whose areas it is in.

name: Prismatic Sphere
note: Layered colours with large damage and effects. Not modelled.

name: Sphere of Ultimate Destruction
note: Annihilating sphere; explosion if touched by a rod of cancellation. Not modelled.

name: Wildwind*
note: Wall of lights doing 2d6 to creatures struck. Not modelled.
